name: Upstox
description: Upstox is a leading platform for trading and investment, offering a range of financial services including stock trading, mutual funds, and more. It provides users with advanced tools and insights to make informed investment decisions.

events.d: Retrieve historical candlestick (open/high/low/close) price data for an instrument over a specified date range and interval.
Get current price and open, high, low, close values for a specified instrument.
Get current prices and quote details for specified instruments.
Retrieve profit-and-loss data for a segment, trade records (paginated), charges breakdown, or a report summary. Filter by financial year or by fixed or relative date range.
Retrieve all trades executed during the current trading day.
Retrieve historical trades for a segment and date range (data limited to the last 3 financial years). Supports relative date filters and pagination.
Find trading instruments matching a search query, with optional filters for exchange, segment, instrument type, expiry, ATM offset, page, and results per page.
